verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI documents assigning a custom identifier when loading a model (`lms load ... --identifier="my-model-name"`), and it serves loaded models through OpenAI-like and REST APIs. The evidence never states that this identifier is what API requests use to reference the model, so the 'consistent reference in API calls' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation that the custom identifier is accepted as the model name in API requests, coverage of persistence or consistency of the identifier across reloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls

citations.quote: Serve local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network
LM Studio provides a REST API that you can use to interact with your local models from your own apps and scripts.
